evidence.observation: Growth T is holding at 749.8 °C against a 750 °C setpoint. It briefly overshot to 760 °C at the ramp-to-growth transition (t=2520), then settled.
Heater power is steady at about 45% during the hold. That is lower than the 83% needed during the ramp, which is expected once the setpoint stops rising.
Ar flow is tracking its setpoint within about ±1 sccm through purge, ramp and growth.
Tube pressure is steady at about 760.5 Torr throughout. No sign of a leak or exhaust blockage.

args.missing_evidence: There is no exhaust O2 sensor, so a small air leak can't be ruled out directly. No reference ranges were provided, so the ~45% hold power can't be checked against normal runs. No sample characterization exists yet.
